description: This Java source file defines the ResumeSource class, which provides mechanisms to create fault-tolerant Akka Streams that can resume processing after failures, with features like exponential backoff, look-behind for seed calculation, and custom error handling.

classes.name: ResumeSource
classes.description: Provides static methods to create fault-tolerant Akka Streams with resumption capabilities, including backoff and seed management.

classes.name: Envelope
classes.description: Marker interface for stream elements, errors, or end-of-stream signals.

classes.name: Element
classes.description: Represents a stream element within the envelope.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Represents an error envelope containing a Throwable.

classes.name: FailureWithLookBehind
classes.description: Encapsulates the final elements before failure and the associated error for backoff and seed calculation.

classes.name: NeverCancelFlow
classes.description: A custom Akka Stream flow that never cancels upstream, used for feedback loops.

classes.name: EndStreamOnEOS
classes.description: A custom GraphStage that completes downstream after an EndOfStream envelope.

classes.name: StatefulBackoffFunction
classes.description: Implements exponential backoff logic for error streams.

classes.name: StatefulLookBehindFunction
classes.description: Maintains a look-behind queue of elements to provide context on failures.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for configuring a ResumeSource.

methods.name: onFailureWithBackoff
methods.description: Creates a fault-tolerant source with exponential backoff, seed management, and failure handling.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the source based on the provided ResumeSourceBuilder configuration.

methods.name: failWithLimitsReached
methods.description: Returns a source that fails with StreamLimitReachedException when limits are exceeded.

methods.name: resumeWithFailuresAppended
methods.description: Creates a flow that appends failure information and look-behind context to the stream.

methods.name: backoff
methods.description: Creates a flow that applies exponential backoff with recovery reset.
